name: @battuta/plugin-harmony
description: The harmony lanes: chord symbols above the staff and Roman numerals below, typed at the caret with completions.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.
dependencies: @battuta/api and nothing else of the workspace. No react: the lanes' floating editor is the host's, and this plugin renders nothing.
